slideDifferences.nativeText:
When we talk about life events or arrangements, we normally work in English using the present progressive structure. Check the following examples.
TO CONSIDER

Using the present progressive with future phrases state future events likely to happen. 
Phrases must state a definite moment mainly.
Be + Ving + Future Phrase
We are attending Joe’s wedding this Saturday.
Are you attending Joe’s wedding this Saturday?
They are graduating from college in some hours.
Are they graduating from college in some hours?
He is getting married in two days.
Is he getting married in two days?

texts: Functional English
Language Targets
Aspects
Examples

Talk about arrangements. Events in life that are most likely to happen. 
-They are hardly modified-

She is opening her own business this month.

My baby is being born this Friday. 

They are attending her first school day tomorrow.
When using present progressive we can consider the following function in the future.
TO CONSIDER
Any action can be inserted here, not only talking about arrangements or life events.

texts: Attending a party!
Mum! Are we attending Lilly’s party?
I still don’t know. Your dad is having a meeting at work that day.
I see. Well, maybe we can go with aunt Melissa.
She is going as far as I know.
Uhm… if she is going, you can go with her then.
I am waiting for your father even if we arrive late.
Ok! What are we getting her as a present? Oh! When are we
buying it?
We are planning to go and buy something on Friday.
Fine, I am going with you, can I?
Totally, we are leaving at 6:00pm. Oh! I am not getting you anything.
Huh! I am staying at home then.

present.						(T) (F)

on Saturday.					(T) (F)
